name: Rainforest QA
description_en:
Rainforest QA is a hosted test-automation service with visual test creation and AI-generated steps. Tests target a configured site and environment; authors can preview generated actions, organize run groups and investigate failures using results evidence. The Visual Editor operates against the visible interface rather than relying solely on DOM selectors.

Its retry and self-healing behavior affect both test meaning and cost. A final pass can follow failed attempts, and a successful regeneration can update the test. Evaluate the intended assertion, attempt history and test-data consumption together instead of treating a recovered pass as proof that the original user requirement was preserved.
description_zh:
Rainforest QA 是托管测试自动化服务，支持可视化创建及 AI 生成步骤。测试对应已配置站点和环境，作者可预览动作、组织 run group 并用结果证据调查失败。Visual Editor 面向可见界面，并非仅依赖 DOM selector。

重试与自愈会同时影响测试含义及费用。最终通过可能发生在多次失败之后，成功重新生成还可能更新测试。应一起检查断言意图、尝试历史和测试数据消耗，不能将恢复后通过等同于原始用户要求已被保留。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure the site/environment and preview generated actions before a run.
core_features.explanation_zh: 运行前配置站点／环境并预览生成动作。

core_features.explanation_en: The Visual Editor describes UI-level interaction rather than DOM-only targeting.
core_features.explanation_zh: Visual Editor 描述 UI 层交互，而非仅 DOM 定位。

core_features.explanation_en: Results distinguish attempts and flag a failure that passes on retry as flaky.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结果区分尝试，将重试后通过的失败标记为 flaky。

en: Pilot a reversible staging flow with an explicit requirement that must never be healed away.
Compare original failures, retries and final results against billable attempts and test-data rows.
zh: 用可逆 staging 流程试点，明确不应被自愈消除的要求。
将原始失败、重试和最终结果与计费尝试及测试数据行比较。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Prepare a reachable staging site with disposable accounts and a precise assertion; preview generated steps.
steps.zh: 准备可达 staging、可丢弃账户及精确断言，预览生成步骤。

steps.en: Check retry/healing conditions, attempt data and the actual order/budget owner before scheduling.
steps.zh: 计划运行前核对重试／自愈条件、尝试数据及实际订单／预算负责人。

items.en: Retry attempts are billable outside trials and can require additional test-data rows.
items.zh: 试用外重试会收费，且可能需要额外测试数据行。

items.en: Self-healing can overwrite manual edits and does not run automatically on preview failures.
items.zh: 自愈可能覆盖人工编辑，且不会因预览失败自动执行。

pricing.summary_en: Published terms use subscription Ordering Documents for actual fees, scope and term; the default term is12 months unless changed by the order. The retry guide explicitly bills additional attempts outside free trials. Budget alerts notify rather than establishing a verified spend stop. No numeric current quote, trial allocation or total cost was obtained.
pricing.summary_zh: 公开条款以订阅 Ordering Document 规定实际费用、范围及期限，订单未改时默认十二个月。重试指南明确试用外额外尝试计费。预算提醒提供通知，未证明停止支出。未取得当前数字报价、试用额度或总价。

sections.title_en: Review the generated actions and assertion
sections.en: The quickstart begins with the site/environment, creates a draft from a natural-language flow and uses Preview to replay steps. Its result triage points to videos and screenshots for finding targeting or timing problems. Use a synthetic, reversible flow with a precise final assertion. No example here was executed and no observed defect-detection rate is claimed.
sections.zh: 快速入门先选择站点／环境，由自然语言流程生成草稿，再用 Preview 重放。结果调查使用视频、截图定位目标或时序问题。应选择模拟、可逆流程及精确最终断言；本次未执行示例，也无实测缺陷检出率。

sections.title_en: Make the test environment deliberately reachable
sections.title_zh: 有意识地配置测试环境可达性
sections.en: The access guide recommends staging/QA close to production, with realistic fake users and datasets. Rainforest’s virtual machines must be able to reach that environment. Verify the intended URL and authentication path using nonproduction credentials; do not weaken production network policy simply to make a draft test run.
sections.zh: 访问指南建议 staging／QA 接近生产配置，并使用真实形态的假用户、数据。Rainforest VM 必须能访问环境。应以非生产凭据核对 URL 和认证路径，不能为运行草稿测试而削弱生产网络策略。

sections.title_en: Retries consume attempts, data and money
sections.title_zh: 重试消耗尝试、数据及费用
sections.en: The retry guide permits at most3 retries, or4 total attempts, and charges retry attempts outside a free trial. Failed/no-result/error tests can be retried; each attempt can receive different test-data values. Too few CSV rows can fail the run. Review attempt-level evidence and budget data for retries, rather than counting only the final passed result.
sections.zh: 重试指南最多允许三次重试、共四次尝试，免费试用外的重试会收费。失败／无结果／错误测试均可重试，每次可能取得不同测试数据；CSV 行数不足可能导致运行失败。应检查每次证据并为重试准备数据，不能仅计最终通过。

sections.title_zh: 原始提示决定重新生成意图
sections.en: The healing guide warns that manually edited generated steps may be overwritten. Its example shows that omitting an explicit consent requirement can let a changed flow pass, while including that requirement preserves a failure. It documents Windows Chromium and exactly one retry for generative healing; preview failure alone does not trigger automatic regeneration. Confirm the current entitlement and these conditions.
sections.zh: 自愈指南警告人工修改的生成步骤可能被覆盖。示例中，未写明同意要求可能使变更流程通过，写明该要求则保留失败。文档列生成式自愈限 Windows Chromium 且重试恰为一次，预览失败本身不触发自动重新生成。应核对当前权益及这些条件。

sections.title_en: A budget alert is a notification setting
sections.title_zh: 预算提醒属于通知设置
sections.en: The billing guide lets the account owner set a usage threshold for notification and manage billing details; other members have limited read-only visibility. It directs subscription cancellation and card removal through support. This evidence establishes billing controls, not a hard spending cap or self-service cancellation guarantee. Review the actual plan and billing owner before scheduling repeated runs.
sections.zh: 账单指南允许账户所有者设置用量通知阈值并管理账单，其他成员只具有受限只读可见性。取消订阅和移除卡需联系支持。这证明账单控制方式，不证明硬支出上限或自助取消保证。计划重复运行前应核对方案与账单负责人。

sections.title_en: Use the actual Ordering Document for fees
sections.title_zh: 以实际 Ordering Document 核对费用
sections.en: The published terms grant hosted use for a subscription term and leave fees and restrictions to an Ordering Document. The default term is12 months unless otherwise specified. They do not supply a universal public per-run rate. Read the selected order, renewal and cancellation conditions together with the documented charge for retries.
sections.zh: 公开条款按订阅期限授予托管使用，费用及限制依 Ordering Document，未另定时默认十二个月。条款未给通用公开单次价格。应结合重试收费说明，核对所选订单、续期与取消条件。
